in_sanskrit.name: Balyaan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Hero
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balyaan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Balyaan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Yan' meaning hero or warrior. It is a name given to a little boy, symbolizing his potential to become a brave and strong hero in his future.
